name: Zigbee / Z-Wave Reconnaissance
description: Zigbee and Z-Wave are low-power mesh protocols used in building automation, smart locks, HVAC control, and lighting systems. Reconnaissance of these protocols can reveal building automation topology and identify smart lock installations that may be vulnerable to replay or protocol attacks. As smart building systems become more prevalent, this attack surface is growing in relevance for physical red team engagements.

blue.det: Zigbee/Z-Wave scanner device near building automation equipment; unexpected commands to smart locks or HVAC.
blue.cm: Use encrypted Zigbee (Zigbee 3.0 with AES-128); change default network keys; monitor building automation for unexpected commands; segment IoT devices from main network.
